text:
Topic: Cell Biology and Genetics

1. Which organelle is commonly referred to as the powerhouse of the eukaryotic cell?
a. Nucleus
b. Ribosome
c. Mitochondria
d. Endoplasmic reticulum
Answer: c. Mitochondria generate most of the cell's ATP via oxidative phosphorylation.

2. Which nitrogenous base replaces thymine in ribonucleic acid (RNA)?
a. Adenine
b. Cytosine
c. Guanine
d. Uracil
Answer: d. RNA utilizes Uracil instead of Thymine.

3. What phase of mitosis involves chromosomes aligning along the equatorial plane?
a. Prophase
b. Metaphase
c. Anaphase
d. Telophase
Answer: b. Chromosomes line up at the metaphase plate during metaphase.
